messages:
Eli (Support): Flagging Alveo onboarding failure — their staging run is hitting repeated 429s and some 502s on embedding validation. Customer can't finish the automated checklist.

Eli (Support): ```
2026-04-02T14:12:08Z embedd status=429 tenant=alveo env=staging pool=us-central-1
2026-04-02T14:13:02Z proxy status=502 upstream=embedd tenant=alveo
```

ops-bot: Incident created ALV-INC-9001 (priority: P2) - elevated embed error rate for tenant alveo.

Nora - CSM: Nora here. Context: Alveo is in active onboarding with a Q2 renewal discussion next week. Are we seeing prod impact? How's customer tone?

Eli (Support): Prod unaffected. Error rate ~25% in staging for last 18m. Customer is annoyed — their onboarding engineer posted: "can't finish checks, this blocks go-live".

Samir - CS Ops: Looping in SRE. Samir will own the comms and add to renewal notes. Quick ask: any recent infra pushes for this tenant?

Hanna (SRE): No infra/model deploys for Alveo in 5d. Traces show a scheduled nightly test hitting staging with many parallel small requests (~150 concurrency). Rate limiter engaged; backend queue spilled leading to 502s. Suggest temporary per-tenant concurrency bump + short-lived quota exemption for staging.

Marta (Enablement): If their CI is aggressively retrying, we should offer a 20m pairing to review batching/backoff. This is a teachable moment for onboarding docs.

Nora - CSM: Suggested immediate comms: 1) acknowledge, 2) say prod unaffected, 3) outline mitigation (temp bump & monitoring), 4) offer rerun of validations and enablement call, ETA 30-60m. I'll draft and send once SRE confirms mitigation.

Hanna (SRE): Applied mitigation at 14:22 UTC: concurrency cap for alveo staging increased 12->48 and temporary quota lift to 1000 req/hr. Monitoring unmuted. Error rate fell to ~3% within 6m. Reversion scheduled 60m out.

Nora - CSM: Draft to send to customer (Alveo contact): "Hi Miguel 0, we saw transient embed failures in your staging workspace caused by a CI test burst. We've applied a temporary configuration to stabilize staging and are monitoring. Prod is not affected. We can rerun your onboarding checks and offer a short enablement session to optimize your CI. ETA for final rollback: 60m unless you ask to extend." Thoughts?

Samir - CS Ops: Clean. Add line: "If you anticipate similar loads in prod, we can propose a dedicated quota/plan ahead of conversion." Also add this incident to the renewal risk tracker with tag "staging-flake".

Eli (Support): Sending message to Miguel now and monitoring channel for reply. I'll capture sentiment.

Marta (Enablement): I'll ping Nora for 2 available slots tomorrow for a 20m pairing. I'll draft a short checklist on batching + backoff to attach in the follow-up.

ops-bot: ALV-INC-9001 status -> monitoring (updates at 14:28, 14:32 UTC).

Eli (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, staging is stable and onboarding checks passed after your change. We'll throttle our CI and would like that enablement call."

Nora - CSM: Marking resolved for now. Follow-ups: (1) Samir add checklist entry to renewal handoff (staging_embed_burst), (2) Marta run enablement pairing, (3) SRE to revert caps at 15:22 unless extended, (4) CSM to note brief friction in renewal deck.

Samir - CS Ops: Added renewal checklist entry and linked ALV-INC-9001. Also scheduled 15m postmortem with SRE in case reversion triggers alerts.

Hanna (SRE): Reversion scheduled and noted in incident. Leaving in monitoring state.

Nora - CSM: Thanks team. I'll update the renewal tracker and follow up after the enablement session. If Alveo requests a permanent quota change, we'll open a billing/ops request and update conversion risk accordingly."
